st-tn-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Tamil Nadu
st-tn-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Tamil Nadu, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-tn-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-tn-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-tn-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Tamil Nadu
st-tn-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Tamil Nadu, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-tn-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-tn-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-tn-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Tamil Nadu
st-tn-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Tamil Nadu, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-tn-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-tn-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-tn-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Tamil Nadu
st-tn-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Tamil Nadu (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-tn-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-tn-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.
